verdict.rationale: incident.io documents an official remote MCP server that lets any MCP-compatible AI assistant connect directly to incident data. It lists concrete capabilities: querying incidents, analyzing alerts, checking on-call, managing escalations and running operational analysis. A probe confirmed the dedicated docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use, and setup/auth detail beyond the overview statements.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The incident.io MCP server lets you connect any AI assistant that supports the Model Context Protocol directly to your incident data.
Query incidents, analyze alerts, check who's on call, manage escalations, and run deep operational analysis — all from your existing AI tools.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.incident.io/ai/remote-mcp
